title: Closing New Program with X silently creates a draft program (no warning, wrong set-up step)
expected: Closing without Save draft / Save program discards the work, or asks 'Keep as draft or discard?'. If a draft is kept, its recorded set-up step matches how far the user got.
actual: 2026-10-27 documentation pass: the New Program dialog was closed with X without clicking Save draft or Save program and with no confirmation — yet 'Programs not running now' rose from 31 to 32 programs with a new row 'DOC TEST PROGRAM — DO NOT SAVE' (Cricket · Ages 10–16, 'Draft · set-up step 2', NEXT STEP Continue). The dialog had reached step 4, so the recorded step 2 is also wrong. Closing the New Class wizard with X did NOT create a class draft, so the two flows behave inconsistently.
steps: Open 'Programs not running now' and look for the new draft row.
